run_convert_musicflamingo_cli: run the CLI to convert MusicFlamingo source weights to Hugging Face format with --src_dir and --dst_dir
create_processor_from_checkpoint: create a MusicFlamingo processor with Whisper feature extractor and Qwen2 tokenizer from source llm directory
merge_model_weights_to_shards: merge and shard weights from llm, sound_tower, and sound_mm_projector into a single Hugging Face model
push_converted_model_to_hub: push the converted MusicFlamingo processor and model to a Hugging Face Hub repository
resolve_safetensors_component: resolve a component directory to find its safetensors index or single weight file for loading
